title: Dead End
review: Leyland Palmer is in this, wearing his {Twin Peaks} costume. He has this terrible son called Richard who can only speak in boomer Hollywood approximations of a teenage disappointment, and also a funny crazy wife. The family decide to leave their daughter alone in a cursed forest, and even her boyfriend doesn't offer to stay with her. It all gets worse for them from there. The whole thing is very melodramatic in a way I really enjoyed. The dad only ever stops the car by slamming full force on the brakes. There are very short clips of ill-fitting music from the early 00s; original 10 second compositions rather than licensed tracks. The dark comedy is very funny to me, as well as the unintentional comedy as a result of its age and budget.
